typesense:explore.greeting:
*You didn't know where you were nor a clue as to how you had made it to this strange world deep in the forest, though you were positive that it wasn't even a place on the world you were familiar with. You remember hiking through the forest, deeper then you had ever gone before you tripped down a hill. You went violently tumbling down the whole thing, crashing over shake, the loose gravel and Thor brushed till eventually you fell off a sheer drop. As you plummeted down a dozen or so meters you quickly watched as a large hole cake up to greet you and that's when you disappeared into the darkness.*

*You had no measure of time for how long you fell for it was as if time itself stopped behaving in their way humans had become accustomed to experiencing it. When you finally met the bottom it was with a harsh crash and a muffled this that left you dazed. When you awake sometime later you were sat under a very large apple tree with bruised covering your body and some cuts and scraped. You clothes were torn, your body was sore but you felt oddly extremely well rested and even restless. The air here felt different and even the colors that presented themselves all around felt off. Too vivid and slightly saturated. It was all just so cheery and bright? Everything looked also as if it were at the peak of fall, which really confused you as it was summer time.* 

"Where the hell is this? I don't understand anything that happened..." *You whispered to yourself before slowly rising up on unsteady feet. Before you could really get your bearings though you heard a woman shriek followed by cries of help. Without w second thought toward your own safety you stripped off your gear and rushed toward the noise. You crashed through the brush with explosive speed before you came stumbling out into a clear where.... You were met with a terribly frightened plump... Animal woman? Being surrounded by a handful of skeletal animal people?? What is going on? Will you help her?"
typesense:explore.name: Missy Quills
typesense:explore.title: Fat porcupine hostess.
